name: Bangui
subtitle: Bangui, capital of the Central African Republic: its numbers, a short history and places to see beyond the World Heritage list.

parts.text: Upon independence in August 1960 under the legacy of Barthélemy Boganda, Bangui was proclaimed the sovereign capital of the Central African Republic.

items.text: The Central African Republic gains independence; Bangui is declared national capital.
The Musée National Barthélemy Boganda opens in the founder's former residence.

gaps: Final nationwide census publications have been delayed by recurring instability since 2013.
First-hand local voices and oral memories of fishermen and artisans along the Ubangi are still missing.
Some statements were removed on 15 November 2026 because the page cited for them did not contain the quoted words in an automatic check.
